name: STP topology change (syslog) + interface util anomaly (broadcast storm, SNMP): L2 loop confirmed
comment: C5: stp_topology_change is already emitted by syslog_control_signal (%SPANTREE-...). The broadcast storm shows as an interface metric anomaly — the independent device_telemetry witness that confirms a loop, not a one-off reconvergence. No coincident link_state_change, so the link-fault discriminator does not fire.
